title: Drive tools and software update in the console
summary: The EtherCAT config tool is part of the console now: drive recipes, drive settings and manual read/write in Settings, drive faults in Diagnostics, and one software update for everything.

changes.title: Driver Settings
changes.description: Recipes, Drive settings and Manual read/write for the servo drives, under Settings > Driver Settings.

changes.title: Drive faults
changes.description: The fault history of each drive, with causes and fixes, under Diagnostics > Robot records > Drive faults.

changes.title: Software update for the whole console
changes.description: Settings > Software Update installs a new version of the whole console, keeps the previous one to go back to, and goes back by itself when a new version does not start.
